notes.title: Version 0.2.0 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Text chat
[*] Keybind for restarting
[*] Turn speed is now influenced by input value
[*] Game gets paused when menu is opened in local play mode
[*] Small bug and performance fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.7 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Added a setting for Blood Quality
	[list]
[*] Currently only affects the blood on the ground
[*] Can have a large performance impact even when no blood is visible yet
[/list]
[*] Added a setting for Field of View
[*] Fixed Shadow Quality setting
 	[list]
[*] Previously the highest setting was never activated
[/list]
[*] Fixed player death handling on clients
	[list]
[*] Name now disappears when the player dies
[/list]
[*] Changed the way hands interact with equipment on death to discourage extreme physics bugs
[*] Increased bloodloss from neck arteries
[*] Added version number to main menu
[*] Slight changes to the layers of the basic movesets
 	[list]
[*] Walking now overrides crouching from blocks or attacks on all movesets
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.6 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed one cause for fps drops/stutter
[*] Fixed a typo in tutorial tasks
[*] Free cameras movement is no longer affected by the timescale
[*] Slightly changed the UI colors
[*] Hidden secret experimental feature(use at your own peril): free camera while the player is still alive
[list]
[*] To enable the feature add "-freecam" to the games launch options on steam
[*] Pressing F1 toggles between follow camera and free camera
[*] Pressing F2 toggles inputs between player character and the camera
[*] There is currently no way to rebind the keys
[*] Only works when there is one camera on the scene. So no split-screen support.
[/list]
[/list]
